settings.title: Global Settings
settings.startAtPastWarning: The start date is in the past.

noLimits.active: No time limits — continuous 24/7 calculation from now
noLimits.hint: Continuous 24/7 calculation from now to the end: company hours, weekends and buffers are ignored.

frozen.active: Fixed calculation — elapsed time is not subtracted
frozen.hint: The result stays as it is: reopening it later doesn't subtract the elapsed time.

weekend.active: Weekend work active — included in the calculation
weekend.hint: Each day runs in its own time window (or 24 h).

buffers.hint: Warm-up at each block start, shutdown before each block end. Skipped on a continuous line.
buffers.continuousHint: Continuous line: warm-up and shutdown are not applied.

orders.title: Order Queue

scan.label: Read Sizes From Photo

orders.revertPiramideHint: Restore the order’s sizes from before the Pyramid

advanced.autoFilledNote: Produced so far — filled from elapsed time

orders.minRequired: At least one order is required.

saved.title: Saved Calculations

saved.trackingOff: Fixed calculation — tap to sync the production from now

stop.title: What's in production now?
stop.hint: {{size}} stops and resumes right after the size you pick. What's produced so far stays as it is — correct it in Advanced if needed.

queue.title: Production order
queue.hint: Drag the sizes (⠿) or use ↑↓ to put them in the order they'll be produced. In the form and results they stay under their order.

results.advanceFailed: Couldn't update this saved calculation to «now» — showing it as saved.

company.readOnlySaved: View only: changes saved on this device only.
company.originalBanner: Published to Production · this is your original: changes stay here until you send them.
company.liveBanner: Production version: changes reach everyone right away.

report.title: Report

report.noClosing: The line runs 24/7: there is no closing.

import.empty: No saved calc with sheet sizes.

link.linkedNoName: Linked to the source order: every “Compute Layout” updates it.

tips.title: 💡 Tips for a good scan
tips.crop: Crop only the Length and Quantity columns: grabbing the side borders, the profile drawing or the Weight/m² columns makes the read worse; a tight crop reads everything.
tips.allRows: Frame all rows (the full table height).
tips.flat: Photo in focus, straight, evenly lit, no glare.
tips.lowConf: If reliability is below 90%, rescan with a tighter crop.
tips.manual: You can fix or add rows by hand, and scan several photos (they add up).

photo.title: Order Photo
photo.hint: Take or upload one or more photos, crop the Length and Quantity columns and read the values. You can also enter them by hand.
photo.crop: Zoom and pan to frame, select the area with Length and Quantity, then read.
photo.readOk: Read {{count}} rows — check and fix below.
photo.readLowConfidence: Read {{count}} rows, but reliability only {{confidence}}% — check nothing is missing or rescan with a tighter crop.
photo.readEmpty: No values recognized. Crop tighter or enter by hand.
photo.readError: Reading failed. Retry or enter by hand.
photo.minLenHint: opt. — default 300; raise to ignore too-short values
photo.maxLenHint: opt. — default 11000; raise to 13500 for extra-long sheets

sheets.title: Sheets
sheets.empty: No sheets. Add rows or read from a photo.

options.title: Options
options.lanesHint: lanes side by side per layer
options.allowScatterHint: off = keep each length together (cleaner cut); on = less waste

result.title: Layout
result.empty: Enter the sheets and press «Compute layout».
result.splitWarning: ⚠ Size {{length}} mm lands in rows of very different length ({{rows}} mm) — better to recalculate.
